constraints: Read-only: it writes only the optional --out JSON. A DEFECT row is a CANDIDATE for one aligned `fnasm --diff` read, never a licence to edit.

Requires a completed `ninja` so build/GUNE5D/obj and build/GUNE5D/src are both current; stale objects silently misreport. It reads the plain src object, NOT the raw pre-postprocess body, so on a webfrank-pinned function it scores the POSTPROCESSED relocations.
It answers the ORDER question only. When the datum MULTISETS differ it returns UNDECIDABLE and never BENIGN, because a value delta is fndiff.datum_multiset_screen's question, not this one.
UNDECIDABLE is a real answer, not a failure: 175 of 3032 paired functions land there, almost all for UNPAIRED mismatches in streams whose relocation counts agree but whose instruction words do not.

Two-sided calibration at 5f9ef72ba: positive control (es_named_reloc_census's 8 TRANSPOSED) 6 DEFECT / 2 UNDECIDABLE / 0 BENIGN; negative control (its 7 WRONG-DATUM) 0 DEFECT / 7 UNDECIDABLE / 0 BENIGN; base rate over 3032 paired functions 12 DEFECT (0.40%), 2845 BENIGN, 175 UNDECIDABLE, 84 seconds.
entrypoint: python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_ordered_datum_screen.py [--census PATH] [--disposition CANDIDATE|'*'] [--unit U --function F] [--sweep] [--out PATH]
name: wf_ordered_datum_screen.py
purpose: The THIRD datum comparison: each function's whole ORDERED sequence of datum keys, target against ours, with every ordered mismatch decided on the REGISTER FIELD -- crossed registers are a schedule reorder, the same register at the same position holding a different datum is a transposition.
usage: Run from the repository root. `--sweep` is the image-wide base rate and needs no census; `--census` re-screens es_named_reloc_census.py's --out (default build/GUNE5D/es_named_census.json); `--unit`/`--function` screens one function.
Positive control to run before trusting a refinement: `--unit game/enemy/enemy --function move_logic00` must print DEFECT with the f30 pi/2pi DATUM-SWAP row.
See claim.law.WF_the-register-slot-separates-a-datum-transposition-from-a-schedule-reorder.20260903.v1 for the rule, the exclusion counts and the 11 CANDIDATE dispositions.
